intro: Use this feet and inches calculator to convert decimal feet to inches cleanly for human height, carpentry framing, drywall sheets, and architectural plans. Because 1 international foot equals exactly 12 inches, multiply any measurement in feet by 12—or pair this tool with our centimeters-to-feet and meters-to-feet pages when you need a metric to feet and inches converter. Check pre-computed spans from 0.5 ft to 200 ft below.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Decimal Feet (5.10 ft) vs. Feet & Inches (5 ft 10 in) & Feet-Inches to Feet
items: 5.10 decimal feet means 5 and 1/10 feet (61.2 inches, or 5 ft 1.2 in), NOT 5 feet 10 inches (which equals 70 inches).
To convert feet and inches to decimal feet (feet inches to feet), divide the inches by 12 and add to the whole feet—for example, 5 ft 10 in = 5 + (10 ÷ 12) = 5.83333 ft.
Structural moment engineers converting kip·ft to kip·in multiply by the same factor of 12 (1 kip·ft = 12 kip·in), since the kip force unit stays unchanged.

faqs.question: How many inches are in 1 foot?
faqs.answer: There are exactly 12 inches in 1 international foot (1 ft = 12 in). Conversely, 1 inch equals 1/12 of a foot (about 0.08333 ft).

faqs.question: How do you convert feet and inches to decimal feet?
faqs.answer: Divide the inches by 12 and add the result to the whole feet. For example, 5 ft 10 in equals 5 + (10 ÷ 12) = 5.83333 decimal feet (or 70 total inches).

faqs.question: What is 5.10 feet in inches?
faqs.answer: 5.10 decimal feet equals 61.2 inches (5 ft 1.2 in). If you meant 5 feet 10 inches, that equals 70 inches (5 × 12 + 10).
